output.reason: [ev-b798a55da05a] says only that the traefik cmd error log is changed to error level. So behavior-changed with after "error" is supported, but nothing gives the earlier level. The free-form name must not include the product name, so "traefik-cmd-error-log-level" becomes "cmd-error-log-level". The after literal should be the plain string error, without embedded quote characters. Logging is not really wire or protocol behaviour, but no other subject family fits better, so I kept protocol-behavior.

correction.statement: The traefik command's error log message is now emitted at error level.
